{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Don't let them laugh at you. They always give the image designers funny looks, but when they want their hair done, who else are they going to call?|An image designer trainer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
An '''Image Designer''' was a professional, whose trade was to offer [[Gender/Legends|his]] or her patrons various physical or esthetical alterations. Those included new haircut or color, markings, [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]], skin or fur color, lip color, cosmetics or eye color.

The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Choster]] once used the services of an Image Designer to change his face when the [[Sulfur Lake Pirates]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] tried to kill him.<ref name="SWG:SwC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak with Choster|Lok}}</ref>
